description: SvDateTimePicker in the five shapes a Svelte 5 form ships: a date-only field, a time-only field, a full date and time field, a 12-hour field with spin buttons and a min and max constrained field, all on one form. Each is a masked text input that can be typed or picked, with a portalled dropdown and an animated calendar, the same component the grid mounts to edit a datetime cell.
keywords: svelte 5 date only time only picker

faq.question: How do I make a date-only field?
faq.answer: Set dropDownDisplayMode='calendar' and a date formatString such as yyyy-MM-dd. The clock tab disappears and the value's time part stays at midnight; 'time' gives the opposite, a clock-only field.

faq.question: How do I constrain the range?
faq.answer: Pass min and max as Dates. Typing a value outside them reverts, and the calendar disables days outside the bounds.

faq.question: What do the spin buttons do?
faq.answer: spinButtons adds up and down arrows to the input that step the focused segment, hour, minute or day, without opening the dropdown.
